name: DDAD: Dense Depth for Autonomous Driving
description: Challenging urban driving benchmark from the Toyota Research Institute for dense long-range (up to 250m) depth estimation, providing 19,680 time-synchronized multi-camera frames (118,080 images) and dense 360-degree point clouds from Luminar solid-state LiDARs across North America and Japan.

citation.paper_title: 3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation

provenance.collection_method: Recorded with six 2.4-megapixel global-shutter cameras providing 360-degree coverage, synchronized with high-resolution long-range (up to 250m) Luminar-H2 solid-state LiDAR sensors.
provenance.curation_notes: Provides extremely dense and accurate long-range ground-truth depth maps generated across diverse urban settings in North America and Japan, serving as a primary benchmark for self-supervised monocular and surround depth estimation.
data_sources: Toyota Research Institute Autonomous Test Vehicles
